charge_element.description: Charge matrix element $\lvert\langle S\vert n_d\vert S^*\rangle\rvert$

current_element.description: Current matrix element $\lvert\langle S\vert\partial_\phi H\vert S^*\rangle\rvert$

element_ratio.description: Ratio of the charge and current matrix elements

gate_ratio.description: Gate splitting over $A_\epsilon\lvert\langle S\vert n_d\vert S^*\rangle\rvert$

phase_ratio.description: Phase splitting over $A_\phi\lvert\langle S\vert\partial_\phi H\vert S^*\rangle\rvert$

symmetric_current_element.description: Current matrix element at $\epsilon_0=0$ (eta selection rule)

averaged_shift.description: Shift of $E_S$ in the time-averaged gate-driven $H_0$

stark_second_order.description: Second-order AC Stark shift, all states

stark_pair_only.description: Second-order AC Stark shift, $S^*$ term only

gate_max_deviation.description: Largest deviation of the gate splitting per amplitude from the charge matrix element, over $\epsilon_0$

phase_ratio_05.description: Phase splitting over the linear law at $\epsilon_0=0.5$

phase_ratio_06.description: Phase splitting over the linear law at $\epsilon_0=0.6$

one_photon_exponent.description: Exponent of the one-photon splitting versus $A_\epsilon$, fitted for $A_\epsilon\le0.1$

two_photon_exponent.description: Exponent of the two-photon splitting versus $A_\epsilon$, fitted for $A_\epsilon\le0.1$
